LanguageData.TM_MagicalVoyagersStartDialog:
The sky split, and two worlds collided. Your ship survived the crossing, but the familiar lands are gone. Three mages stand on the surface of a strange planet.

Your small ship carries a magical core, thrusters and beacons for journeys across this world. Use the pilot console to launch when you are ready. Fuel is limited; replenish it before longer voyages.

Shelter, supplies and further research are yours to earn. The rest of your journey begins here.
LanguageData.TM_MagicalSurfaceOnly: This scenario must start on the planet surface.
